weights: 5/(N+1), equal total per complete rollout; no artificial class balancing
PCA: per scope, training-only raw landmarks at capped j=0,32,64,128,192; randomized PCA K2 per layer
scaling: per scope, training-only PCA landmark mean/std
fit: L2 weighted logistic, fixed C=.01; constant/linear/diagonal; every valid j incl EOS
sample_size: 433 labeled responses, NOT number of tokens; 67 X excluded from losses and metrics
within: 3 folds of complete responses; prompt/class round-robin; metrics conditional on prompt and fold
transfer: leave-one-labeled-prompt-out, nine tasks; single-class held-out AUROC undefined
final: all labeled responses; predictions for X have no observed targets and are NOT new labels
lexical: full-response terminal unigram TF-IDF and repetition/length controls, same scopes, C=1 fixed
model_selection: no hyperparameter or layer search on held-out results
caveats: Post-hoc AI labels, not independent human validation.
Only three tasks have positives; two have a single positive. Holding out culinary leaves two positives for training.
j0 is identical within each prompt; pooled cross-prompt AUROC at j0 can reflect task identity.
j states contain generated prefix; terminal predictions are retrospective, not pre-generation forecasts.
No Hamiltonian dynamics or causal alignment claim.
